Game Overview

In Line of Defense 2, the core idea is straightforward: quickly obliterate waves of colorful tanks as they charge toward the thin red line. Strategically use your machine gun and unleash devastating special attacks to survive. With tanks racing in multiple lanes at varying speeds, your reflexes and tactical acumen are crucial. Will you hold the line?
